layer_channels: all channels at actual model.15/model.21 outputs; never use target-selected TSFL24 as retention coordinates
roi_policy: original masked_prototype min mass1, original P3 image eligibility; explicit unmatched/invalid GT counts and shared-GT views; no silently invented ROI
size_bins: original GT area <32^2 small, <96^2 medium, otherwise large, matching existing TRAIN32 manifest descriptive scale
GT_proxy: same Frozen clean/poison actual EOT forward outputs; detached shared clean native all-GT TAL; native same-TAL alone only for uncovered valid GT; original box/BCE19/DFL gains, object/class means; diagnostic only
protect_proxy: weighted BG + weighted rel + lambda_adapt*original Adaptive target

decision_rule.P5_eligibility: P3 no-op must pass, actual finite effective gradients/budgets/unchanged models, no missing original valid P3 ROI in P5
decision_rule.P5_evidence: both independent batches must show no worsening final protection proxy, no higher paired gradient conflict, improvement in same-native-GT detection delta with consistent perclass/size support, and static/five-step consistency; raw cross-layer loss magnitude alone never selects P5
decision_rule.mixed_or_weak_or_unsupported: retain P3; report every unfavorable class and signal
decision_rule.cost: report peak memory and elapsed time including diagnostic overhead; do not treat observer-heavy timings as native production throughput
